items.statement: Submission documents converged ionic/electronic calculations and explicit endpoint and transition-state validation for named support/thickness cases.
items.expected: Per-case convergence criteria, endpoint identity checks and TS connectivity/curvature evidence are present.

items.statement: Bader charge transfer is assigned to the outermost CoO layer versus the noble-metal substrate with a stated sign convention.
items.expected: Charge partition is reproducible and per-case, not an unsupported global claim.

items.statement: The 1-ML Pt-supported CoO case has a strongly exergonic CO+lattice-O reaction and a finite validated barrier.
items.expected: Reaction energy is approximately −1.66 eV and barrier approximately 1.44 eV when the author's primary convention is used.

items.statement: For 1-ML films, reactivity varies Pt > Pd > Au > Ag and increasing oxide-to-metal charge transfer accompanies more favorable reactivity.
items.expected: Reported completed cases support that ordering or clearly explain deviations with sensitivity evidence.
